title: Quarter Volume Library Prep Step 3: End Prep
author: Opentrons
materials: The protocol will alert the user to ensure reagents are present on deck in sufficient volume.
Magnets are disengaged and the process is complete. Proceed with incubation on off-deck thermocycler.

steps.title: Select pipettes and sample range
steps.instruction: Choose the multi‑channel P20 and P300 pipettes for the run, which are suitable for processing 48–96 input samples.

steps.title: Enter magnetic engage height
steps.instruction: Before starting, input the engage height parameter for the custom labware on the magnetic module as prompted by the protocol.

steps.title: Pre‑cool temperature module
steps.instruction: Set the Temperature Module to 4 °C using the OT app and allow it to reach the set temperature before proceeding.

steps.title: Verify reagent volumes
steps.instruction: Confirm that all required reagents (enzyme mix, EP buffer, etc.) are present on the deck in sufficient volume; the protocol will alert you if any are missing.

steps.title: Prepare mastermix with p300
steps.instruction: Using the P300 multi‑channel pipette, employ a single tip on the rear‑most channel to:

substeps.instruction: Deliver the enzyme mix into the mastermix tube.
Deliver the EP buffer into the same mastermix tube.
Mix the contents to form the mastermix.
Dispense the completed mastermix into the first column of the reagent plate.

steps.title: Dispense mastermix to library plate
steps.instruction: With the P20 multi‑channel pipette, transfer the mastermix from the first column of the reagent plate into the corresponding wells of the library prep plate.

steps.title: Transfer sample and mix
steps.instruction: Using the P20 multi‑channel pipette, aspirate 12.5 µL of the eluted sample (from part‑2) from the bead pellets on the magnetic module and dispense it into the library prep plate wells, then mix each well.

steps.title: Disengage magnets and incubate
steps.instruction: Disengage the magnetic module, then remove the plate and place it on an off‑deck thermocycler for the required incubation.
